Klasse PlotSet<T extends PlotGraph<T>>

java.lang.Object
treptowkolleg.plot.PlotSet<T>
Typparameter:
T - the concrete subclass of PlotGraph contained in this set
public abstract class PlotSet<T extends PlotGraph<T>> extends Object
An abstract base class that groups a plot grid and a type-safe list of plot graphs of the same concrete type. This class provides a structured container for managing a coherent set of visual elements that belong together in a single plotting context.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • PlotSet

      public PlotSet()
      Constructs a new PlotSet with an empty grid as the default coordinate system. Subclasses may replace the grid by calling setGrid(PlotGrid) in their constructor.

    • setGridPosition

      public void setGridPosition(GridPosition gridPosition, JPanel frame)
      Sets the position of the coordinate grid relative to the drawing panel. This method delegates to the contained PlotGrid instance.
      Parameter:
      gridPosition - the desired grid position of (GridPosition)
      frame - the drawing panel used to compute layout dimensions

    • setZoomX

      public void setZoomX(double amount)
      Sets the horizontal zoom factor for the plot grid. Values greater than 1.0 zoom in; values between 0 and 1 zoom out. This method delegates to the contained PlotGrid instance.
      Parameter:
      amount - the zoom factor to apply on the x-axis

    • setZoomY

      public void setZoomY(double amount)
      Sets the vertical zoom factor for the plot grid. Values greater than 1.0 zoom in; values between 0 and 1 zoom out. This method delegates to the contained PlotGrid instance.
      Parameter:
      amount - the zoom factor to apply on the y-axis

    • getGraphs

      public PlotGraphList<T> getGraphs()
      Returns the list of plot graphs contained in this set. The returned list is type-safe and preserves the self-referential generic relationship of the graph type.
      Gibt zurück:
      the list of graphs

    • createControl

      public PlotControl<T> createControl(PlotApplication app)
      Creates a plot control window associated with this plot set. This method is called by PlotApplication when user interaction with the set is required (e.g., when switching to this set for the first time).

      Subclasses that support interactive parameter adjustment should override this method to return a concrete PlotControl instance. If no control is needed, the default implementation returns null.

      Parameter:
      app - the plot application that will manage this control
      Gibt zurück:
      a new PlotControl instance, or null if this set has no UI controls

    • preSetup

      public void preSetup(PlotApplication frame)
      Called before this plot set becomes active. Subclasses may override this method to configure grid position, zoom levels, or other visual properties specific to this set.
      Parameter:
      frame - the PlotApplication instance that is switching to this set

    • postSetup

      public void postSetup(PlotApplication frame)
      Called after this plot set is deactivated. Restores default grid settings (centered grid position and unit zoom). Subclasses may override this method if a different cleanup behavior is desired.
      Parameter:
      frame - the PlotApplication instance that is leaving this set
